name: Chaise lounge facing the window, a reading corner left of the window, KALLAX play wall with Maddie's reading chair
notes:
Alternative: No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
A lounge layout: the KIVIK with chaise floats with its back to the open side and faces the window, the chaise on the right end toward the play area, with the LACK console behind it; no coffee table (the chaise is the footrest). The window's left corner is a grown-up reading corner (POÄNG and TÅGARP), and the play wall is KALLAX: a 2x4 on the upper section, a 2x2 with drawer inserts in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, and Maddie's own reading corner in the window corner with her POÄNG and the FLISAT book display.
sofa-2 KIVIK with chaise, rot 180, chaise on the right end (toward the play area), drawn as its 110.25 x 64.125" bounding box, x 94-204.25, y 62.5-126.625: the chaise reaches y 62.5 and the three seats' front is at y 89.25 (the 3-seat KIVIK's 37 3/8" depth); the chaise's tip 56.5" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); the console and the 30" walkway behind it (F-39); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22, 5 boxes).
console-1 LACK console, x 121.562-176.688, y 126.625-142, against the sofa's back, facing the dining side, with lamp-2 STORSEGEL; plant-1 FEJKA at its left end (x 110-119, y 130-139); 1" short of the walkway (F-42).
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the left arm, x 72.375-94, y 105-126.625: it holds the drinks in place of a coffee table.
chair-1 POÄNG in the window's left corner facing into the room, x 82-108.75, y 18-50.25: 12" from the heater face (F-33), left of the window (F-38); floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP beside it (x 72.5-81.5, y 18-27). 39" of floor between it and the seats' front (y 50.25 to 89.25) is the way from the stair strip into the room.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 90-208, y 40-134: under the sofa and the reading chair's front legs.
kid-chair-1 POÄNG kid's armchair facing west in the window corner, x 239-261, y 22-40.5: 16" from the heater face (F-33); book-display-1 FLISAT beside it facing the room (x 250-261, y 42-61.25); wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST over the chair; art-2 RÖDALM on the window wall above the corner. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
bookcase-1 KALLAX 2x4 standing, right-upper wall x 245.625-261, y 62.875-93: books and display out of reach above, GNABBAS baskets in the four low cubes; anchor-required (F-21, 57 5/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32).
bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2, right-lower wall x 260.125-275.5, y 98-128.125: two KALLAX drawer inserts and two DRÖNA boxes; anchor-required (F-21, 30 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32); 14.9" short of the open side's walkway (F-42). art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies above it.
rug-2 VALLABY 39 x 52", x 210-249, y 86-138; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 210-234.75, y 104-122.875: outside the KALLAX units' 24" (F-32), its lower chair 9" above the walkway (F-42), 5.75" past the chaise.
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the KALLAX 2x2 (30 1/8" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall her reading corner and the KALLAX 2x4.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the second KALLAX 2x2 (only 50" of the right-lower wall is left of the walkway); the 3-seat KIVIK and LACK coffee table (the chaise replaces them); the BESTÅ pieces (a, d), TROFAST (a, b) and SMÅSTAD (a, b, d), KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE (d), the BISSA, hooks and PERJOHAN (the bottom wall is open), LAUTERS.
Stairs: nothing on the x 0-36 band (F-40, assumed-position:stairs); both 36" landings stay clear, and the 36" strip beside the band (x 36-72) is kept as a walkway joining them: the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip (F-30). Nothing she can climb stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown.
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open; the hooks are gone, and the LILJETRÄD mirror hangs on the window wall above the top landing.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; storage over 27" is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, KALLAX insert with 2 drawers x2, DRÖNA boxes x2, GNABBAS baskets x4 (the 2x4's low cubes).
